T: Green girl. Pink girl. One table.
D: Before Dorothy arrived, a green-skinned student and a bubbly blonde became unlikely friends at Shiz University.
P: Serve the snacks when Elphaba and Galinda dance at the Ozdust Ballroom.
S: Ozdust salmon blinis and beetroot hummus
the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, and pink beetroot hummus on crackers. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a snip of chives. Blitz 1 drained tin chickpeas with 1 cooked beetroot, 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth and bright pink. Spoon onto 16 water crackers and top with crumbled feta. Arrange both on a platter.
Avocado, thawed peas, lime juice and mint blitzed bright green with salt, served with cucumber sticks and crackers.
Egg whites whipped glossy with caster sugar and a drop of pink colouring, piped into kisses, baked at 100C for an hour, with raspberries.
M: the dining hall at Shiz University

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice. Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill with the mixture. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley. Slice the chicken and spoon over the lemon butter sauce, with rice on the side.
Elphaba and Galinda's trip to the Emerald City
Arborio stirred with hot stock for 20 minutes, peas and spinach blitzed in at the end with butter and parmesan until bright green.
W: Vanilla sponge batter split in two, one tinted pink and one green, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with vanilla buttercream.
K: the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom
Fresh lemonade turned pink with a splash of cranberry and topped with raspberries.

s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed peas, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and salt until smooth and very green. Spoon into a bowl and serve with cucumber sticks and water crackers. It is green, it is bold, and it is not sorry about it.

Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a drop of pink food colouring. Pipe small kisses onto lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour, then cool in the oven. Serve popular and pink with raspberries.

m.note: Elphaba and Galinda's trip to the Emerald City
m.how: Stir 300g arborio rice in butter, then add 1.25L hot stock a ladle at a time for 20 minutes. Blitz 200g peas with 100g spinach and a splash of stock until smooth. Stir through the risotto with more butter and grated parmesan until bright green.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Split the batter in two, tint one pink and one green and bake in separate tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Cool and stack with vanilla buttercream made with icing sugar.

d.note: the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom
d.how: Mix the juice of 6 lemons with 150g sugar until dissolved, then add 1L cold water and 100ml cranberry juice to turn it pink. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and float a few raspberries on top.
